revision_note: Before any checkpoint evaluation, reduce the symmetry-panel values to the parent-specified bounded set and add a distinct float32-model reconstruction tolerance. Formulas and inferential scope are unchanged. The prior unevaluated version is retained as normalization_protocol_v1_draft_before_scope_alignment.json.
status: exploratory mathematical comparability audit; not HPO efficacy evidence
candidate_selection_basis: Two candidates fixed from explicit symmetry requirements and exact local curvature identities. Previously observed trajectory correlations were not used to choose formulas, aggregation, transformations, or tolerances.

evaluation_scope.checkpoints: All 16 final checkpoints in sibling trajectory-pilot: seeds 31 and 47 crossed with configuration IDs 0 through 7; no subsets or exclusions
evaluation_scope.examples: Cached MNIST official-training x_train indices [0,1500), with exactly the pilot's float32 preprocessing; do not access validation examples or any labels, losses, or official test arrays
evaluation_scope.numeric_policy: Saved model inference on CPU; convert frozen penultimate activations, head kernel and bias to float64; recompute softmax with stable centering for every transformation
evaluation_scope.source_policy: Do not edit original/corrected production code, manuscript, checkpoint, or existing evidence; retain all outputs and numerical failures

notation.h: B by D nonnegative penultimate ReLU activations
notation.W: D by K Keras final Dense kernel
notation.b: K-dimensional final bias, unchanged by every panel transformation
notation.W_c: W - mean(W, axis=1, keepdims=True), equivalently W @ (I_K - ones(K,K)/K)
notation.z_c: z - mean(z, axis=1, keepdims=True), equivalently centered log(p)

original_score.name: original_rms_ratio_max
original_score.formula: max over fixed consecutive 64-example batches b of RMS(p_b) * RMS(h_b) / RMS(W)
original_score.last_batch: include final partial batch of 28, as in the existing 1500-example implementation
original_score.role: unchanged comparator; no new theorem claim

candidates.formula: mean_i [(1 - sum_k p_ik^2) * sum_j h_ij^2 * sum_k W_c[j,k]^2]
candidates.aggregation: arithmetic mean over all 1500 examples, not a maximum over batches; no division by hidden width and no normalization across checkpoints
candidates.interpretation: Exact trace of the final-kernel categorical-cross-entropy Hessian expressed in local perturbations deltaW_j = norm(W_c[j,:]) * deltaTheta_j, with row scales fixed at the audited checkpoint. A zero row scale makes this coordinate map singular; no invertibility is assumed.
candidates.known_failure: Uniformly duplicating every hidden neuron r times and splitting its outgoing weights by r reduces this score by exactly 1/r, despite unchanged predictions. Bias/hidden redistribution and cancelling hidden paths can also change the score.
candidates.scope_limit: A separately defined local relative-coordinate head metric; neither a repaired lower bound for the published proxy nor an invariant measure of the full network or generalization

candidates.aggregation: arithmetic mean over all 1500 examples; no width, class-count, or across-checkpoint normalization
candidates.interpretation: Exact second derivative at alpha=1 of mean categorical cross-entropy with logits alpha*z_c, treating each model's current centered logits as fixed. Equivalently mean Var_{k~p_i}(log p_ik). Independent of labels.
candidates.known_failure: Uniform predictions have value zero, and saturated predictions approach zero; confidence on wrong labels cannot be distinguished from confidence on correct labels. This is not a model-selection guarantee.
candidates.scope_limit: An output-confidence curvature control with changed scientific meaning, not original weight-space flatness or a repair of the paper's theorem

diagnostic_not_third_candidate.name: unweighted_exact_head_trace
diagnostic_not_third_candidate.purpose: Show that exact raw final-kernel curvature itself changes under positive rescaling and duplication; do not select among metrics using this diagnostic

common_uniform_row_shift.formula: W_new = W + c; h and b unchanged

common_nonuniform_row_shift.formula: v = linspace(-2,2,D); W_new = W + v[:,None]; h and b unchanged

global_positive_rescale.formula: h_new = h/s; W_new = s*W; b unchanged; realizable by scaling penultimate affine kernel and bias by 1/s

per_unit_positive_rescale.formula: h_new[:,j] = h[:,j]/s_j; W_new[j,:] = s_j*W[j,:]; b unchanged

hidden_permutation.formula: reverse all hidden columns and corresponding output-kernel rows; b unchanged

uniform_hidden_duplication.formula: Repeat each hidden column r times and each corresponding output-kernel row r times divided by r; b unchanged

analytic_expectations.predictions: unchanged under every panel transformation; centered logits unchanged even when raw logits receive a common-class shift
analytic_expectations.relative_head_trace_uniform_duplication: ratio = 1/r; report as a demonstrated limitation, not failed numerical implementation
analytic_expectations.original_nonuniform_rescale_or_gauge_shi: no invariant-score expectation; report all changes without choosing favorable examples

numerical_tolerances.policy: Record every numerical failure without changing tolerance or excluding a checkpoint. Do not clip or smooth scores to improve findings; small negative variance from roundoff may be reported explicitly. Use absolute comparisons when a baseline metric is zero instead of undefined ratios. Argmax differences at probability ties should be reported separately, not mistaken for a theoretical symmetry failure.

required: all expected invariances and known noninvariances
reporting.forbidden_inference: Do not report improved early selection, validation correlation, final accuracy, or generalization from this inference-only invariance panel. Scores are distinct from the original method and must not replace historical results.
